title: PMK 11/2025: telecom, commodity, KSO and FTZ bases
summary: Add express film/telecom/token/voucher, LPG/fertiliser, member-to-KSO and creditor-collateral calculations plus six KPBPB base paths, preserving fee versus face-value bases and conditional facility exceptions. Gold/crypto histories are omitted pending their later amending-instrument review.
